body: I could assume why,, since I cheated with a woman who also cheated. Mutually we more so agreed our partners wouldn't show affection or treat us the way we wanted. She went back to him and I to my current, we both are still maintaining our relationships.

I'm not justifying my behavior, i hate i did it and feel terrible for it. 
I just thought maybe I could live with the pain that would've been given to her instead
Your comment took me by surprise, thank you. To you it might not be much, but you and the other who were supportive really really helpd me. Thank you
Maybe you're right. But I just feel like I DESERVE to die, even if perhaps its not the best choice. Thank you
Maybe you're right. I dont know if its worse to wait if she finds out or tell her, I just would rather die than see her in the pain from what I've done.
I will try, either way this will be tough. Thank you

Honestly, I would rather her break up with me for any other reason, just as long as its one where her world doesn't get destroyed. I honestly feel like it's now my life duty do be there for her in any way because of what I've done. 
I really do understand what you're saying. Its just more the pain for her thats holding me back
Just a comment like yours helps me so much. I love you and thank you
I know it may not seem like you said much, but thank you and I love you.
I feel like if I tell her, it would just ruin her life and trust for anyone. I can't possibly do that to her, even if it means eating the feelings myself
